title: Metabase Scheduled Subscription Failures
dataSources: Superset logs (`superset:app`, Celery worker/beat), Metabase logs (`metabase:app`), Redash query logs, app repository tables (query cache, dashboard views), embedding/SDK error events via HEC.
app: Apache Superset / Metabase / Redash application logs via Universal Forwarder or container stdout; Celery worker metrics and app repository databases via Splunk DB Connect.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=metabase:app event=pulse_send
| stats count as sends, sum(eval(status="error")) as failures by pulse_name, channel
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Monitors Metabase pulses/subscriptions and flags failed deliveries so recipients keep getting their scheduled dashboards.
value: Silent subscription failures leave stakeholders without expected reports; catching them preserves trust in the tool.
implementation: Ingest Metabase logs; schedule hourly; alert on repeated failures.
visualization: Table of failing pulses, timechart of delivery failures.
grandmaExplanation: We make sure Metabase's scheduled report emails actually send, so nobody misses one.
